name: @elizaos/plugin-automaton-token-safety
description: Token-safety intelligence for ElizaOS agents on Base: bytecode honeypot scan, ERC-20 approval drain-risk audit, buy/sell honeypot simulation, liquidity depth and LP-burn evidence, and newest-pool risk feed. Paid per call with x402 in USDC; gas is sponsored by the CDP facilitator, so agents need no ETH.

AUTOMATON_SIGNER_KEY.description: Optional. Key used ONLY to sign EIP-3009 USDC authorizations for paid calls. Unset = unpaid calls (free trial or a reported 402).

AUTOMATON_MAX_UNITS.description: Per-call cap in USDC base units (default 10000 = $0.01).

AUTOMATON_DRY_RUN.description: Set to 1 to sign but not send paid requests.
